title: Three-span continuous beam by moment distribution

rubric.text: The response should treat the end supports as pinned (modified stiffness 3EI/L and the propped fixed-end moment wL^2/8, or an equivalent exact method), and find the end-span maximum where the shear is zero rather than at midspan.

expert_notes: FEM BA = 40 x 64/8 = 320.0 (far end pinned), FEM BC = 40 x 100/12 = 333.3. Symmetric: DF = (3/8)/(3/8 + 2/10) = 0.652; MB = 320 + 0.652 x 13.33 = 328.7. RA = 160 - 328.7/8 = 118.9; end span maximum 118.9^2/80 = 176.8 at 2.97 m; middle 500 - 328.7 = 171.3. End supports treated as fixed: MB = 299.0, end span 88.5. Midspan of the end span instead of the maximum: 155.6 (outside the tolerance).
